data.long_meaning: Arka is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Arka', which means the radiance of the sun. In Hindu mythology, Arka is the name of the sun god. The name is deeply rooted in the spiritual significance of the sun, which represents vitality, power, and enlightenment. The name Arka carries the meaning “Sun's radiance” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Arka usually hope their child will grow to embody sun's radiance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
